definitions.explanation: A referee who assists the main referee in officiating a game, often responsible for sideline calls.

examples.japanese: {副審|ふくしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オフサイド→オフサイド：06596_ofusaido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
{副審|ふくしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旗|はた}→旗：02161_hata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副審|ふくしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In a soccer match, there are two assistant referees.

notes:
{副審|ふくしん} assists the ⟦{主審|しゅしん}→主審：09268_shushin⟧ (head referee) in officiating games. In soccer, they patrol the sidelines and make offside calls. In other sports, they may have different specific duties.

- {副審|ふくしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as assistant referee)
- {副審|ふくしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧ (assistant referee's signal)
- {副審|ふくしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旗|はた}→旗：02161_hata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (assistant referee waves the flag)
